author: TheCrazySof
body:
Which platform? Teamspeak, In-game, Slack?: In game

Staff Member: alexanderjoe

Guilty? (Yes or No): no

Why do you think your infraction should be removed?: I was given an infraction for "team grief". So I was playing defense and there was this really stubborn person that kept placing fences around the monument claiming it was going to keep people out so I kept breaking them and he kept placing. I kept telling him to stop yet he wouldn't listen. and then someone places a chest like 2 blocks from the monument and I break it to MOVE it to another spot where it wouldn't interfere with anything. So then Alex kicks me for team grief before setting up the new chest. I don't think it was fair because Alex didn't know I was going to move the chest and he didn't even give me a chance to. I also don't think it was fair that he kicked me and not the other guy that was clearly messing with the defense I created.

Thanks for your time,
TheCrazySof
